approval.userText: 漂浮工厂的能力实际上换成升级的icon吧，然后做吧
approval.interpretedDecision: approve recommended option B implementation, replacing the world-space floating workshop carrier ability with an independent upgrade icon

forbiddenWriteRoots: factory src, templates and shared tests

required: remove the world-space 浮标工坊 station, label, interaction radius and route-line implication
preserve purchaseCarrierUpgrade and the exact seven-item test API, but invoke visible carrier purchases through an independent DOM upgrade icon and compact panel
implement fish to kelp to shrimp to crab progressive unlock
implement active-session autonomous shrimp batch buffering and crab ready-slot buffering
implement independent shrimp and crab shelves, customer demand and shortage behavior
implement local fish-net speed, shrimp-soak-speed and crab-ready-capacity upgrades
migrate save-v4 and the existing real save-v3 chain to save-v5 without losing existing state
preserve fish, kelp, movement, checkout, physical tokens, mobile layout and otter animation
explicitlyOutOfScope: offline trap production while the app is closed
employees, backend services, database, queue service or technology tree
shelf upgrades, checkout upgrades or kelp production upgrades
formal generated shrimp or crab image assets
WeChat, Douyin or TapTap publishability claims

upgradeOwnership.globalCarrierEntry: independent upgrade icon using the existing approved upgrade.png; icon panel explicitly says 背篓容量 and never appears as a world building
upgradeOwnership.worldWorkshop: remove entirely; no capability, label, station or path endpoint remains
upgradeOwnership.fishNet: local station upgrade changes pickup interval 520ms to 440ms only
upgradeOwnership.shrimpTrap: local station upgrade changes soak cycle 4200ms to 3500ms only
upgradeOwnership.crabPot: local station upgrade changes ready capacity 1 to 2 only

products.productionMode: continuous proximity pickup after same-node investment
products.prerequisite: first sale then existing tide-pool investment

products.productionMode: active-session autonomous soak adds a batch to visible station buffer
products.prerequisite: kelp unlocked and 18 completed total sales

products.productionMode: active-session autonomous latch adds one to visible ready count
products.prerequisite: shrimp unlocked and 10 completed shrimp sales

disclosureRules: show at most one text-heavy primary objective and one secondary red-dot signal
do not show crab requirement text before shrimp is unlocked
locked source investment consumes no coins until its familiar sales prerequisite is complete
new customer demand starts atomically with source and shelf availability

customerRules.shrimpFallback: after half of stock patience, switch at most once to an in-stock fish or kelp product; otherwise continue waiting
caps: retain global maxActive 5 for first tuning
at most one waiting shrimp customer and one waiting crab customer; excess new-product demand falls back to fish at spawn
retain FIFO checkout and 700ms player-proximity service

mustPreserve: currency, current carrier tier and capacity
fish and kelp carrying and shelves
in-flight customers, checkout queue and shell tokens
next IDs, random seed, simulation time and telemetry
defaults: shrimp and crab locked with zero investment and empty buffers
total completed sales derived from trustworthy telemetry.completedOrders; shrimp sales zero
timers clamped to the current configured cycle and buffers clamped to visible capacity

upgradeIcon: use the existing approved /assets/upgrade.png as an independent DOM icon, not a scene station
anchor in the existing lower-right safe-area quick-control region without covering the status card or drag field
show a red dot only when the next carrier tier exists, prerequisite is met and currency is sufficient
open a compact panel with 背篓容量 current→next, one cost and one confirm button; max state says 已满级
button and confirm target are at least 44 CSS px and keyboard focusable
facilityPrompts: fish net locally states 渔网速度 520→440ms · 48
shrimp trap locally states 浸泡 4.2→3.5秒 · 80
crab pot locally states 待取上限 1→2 · 98
local prompts appear only after the player has experienced the corresponding facility and never imply carrier capacity
portraitConstraints: do not add four persistent stock counters to the top HUD; use local shelf counts and at most two compact operational signals
only the next locked facility shows requirement copy
animationConstraints: preserve three-direction eight-frame otter animation and reduced-motion static pose
use elapsed-time visual feedback and preload existing textures before first visibility
do not serialize visual-only animation state

redCommands: pnpm test -- tests/gameplay.test.ts tests/persistence.test.ts tests/ui-shell.test.ts tests/browser-contract.test.ts
record exit code, failed and passed counts, and expected missing-feature reasons before production edits
requiredFailingBehaviors: world workshop is absent and independent upgrade icon semantics exist
shrimp batches by two and stops at four
crab latches one and stops at ready cap, then cap upgrade reaches two
four products share one carrier capacity and independent shelves
progression order and customer fallback rules
save-v4 to save-v5 preserves in-flight state and defaults new fields

reuse: existing background, fish, kelp, character atlases and upgrade.png
existing style-lock palette and flat-vector geometry
placeholders: draw original shrimp, crab, trap, pot and locked silhouettes with Phaser Graphics primitives in code
do not use emoji, third-party assets, copied silhouettes or downloaded content
assetPolicy.transparencyRule: no new raster transparency deliverable is produced in this build; any later formal transparent asset requires meaningful-alpha verification and light/dark/saturated composites

deliverables: captured RED and GREEN command evidence under artifacts/revisions/seaside-v6-implementation/evidence
